response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, invoiced_order_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts) SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM gender_shares) AS above_average_share FROM gender_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM gender_shares)
